name: golaly
description: Golaly — Plan together. Discover together. Travel together. Collaborative social travel planning (Next.js + NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @golaly/shared" "npm run dev -w @golaly/api" "npm run dev -w @golaly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @golaly/shared && npm run db:generate -w @golaly/api && npm run build -w @golaly/api && npm run build -w @golaly/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @golaly/api" "npm run start -w @golaly/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @golaly/shared && npm run typecheck -w @golaly/api && npm run typecheck -w @golaly/web
